author: Argus
title: Renewing a live session in place resets its spending window under the same session id
summary: Re-authorizing an unrevoked session id advances its generation and resets the per-window spend counter while keeping the cumulative total. The same id, live the whole time, regains a fresh allowance, and every payment signed against the previous generation dies.

matcher.notes: authorizeSession(Session,bytes) 0x35ed738d, revokeSession(bytes32) 0xa7fed385, pay(Payment,bytes) 0x6f3d8f09. selectors derived from source and ABI, membership checked against the deployed runtime

money_bound.expression: the per-window allowance, reset on demand while the total survives, so the effective spend between revocations is limited by the session total and not by the window

reproduction.expected: the control shows the total is a hard stop; the renewal resets the window counter under the same id and refuses a payment signed under the old generation

confirmed_on.target: ClausProjectWallet 0x182905eea41b06f63adef50cee6f104255474ecf chainId 11155111, all six ABI functions present in the runtime

fix: State that renewal is an allowance reset, or carry the window across renewals.

evidence: every generation is a fresh allowance (fuzz, testFuzzF1)
renewal under the same live id succeeds without a revoke
